item.title: COMMONS Lab
item.description: The COMMONS Lab develops computational metabolomics and knowledge-management approaches for natural products research. Within DBGI, the lab contributes workflows for sampling metadata, metabolomics data interpretation, linked open data, and reusable scientific knowledge.

item.title: Knowledge Technologies Unit
item.description: The Knowledge Technologies Unit contributes expertise in semantic web technologies, FAIR data, federated knowledge graphs, and AI-assisted exploration of structured scientific data. Within DBGI, the team supports knowledge-graph and interoperability workflows.

item.title: Plant Ecology and Metabolomics Group
item.description: The Plant Ecology and Metabolomics Group connects plant biodiversity, ecological interactions, and chemical diversity through metabolomics and bioinformatics. Within DBGI, PGEM contributes ecological framing, experimental design, and plant-metabolome expertise.

item.title: Pluskal Lab
item.description: The Pluskal Lab combines metabolomics, mass spectrometry, molecular networking, bioinformatics, and machine-learning approaches to study plant specialized metabolites. Within DBGI, the lab contributes analytical and computational expertise for profiling botanical collections.
